title: Visit table length bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $C,e$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. For every natural number $N$ and every $t\le N$, the table of the first $t$ visit rows for $M,C,e,x$ has length at most $t\,k(2N+6)$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite-state binary Turing machine M with k work tapes
Natural number t with t ≤ N
replaced: For every source machine, parameters, instance, horizon $N$, and count $t \le N$, the ordered table of the first $t$ visit rows has length at most $t \cdot k(2N+6)$, quadratic in the unary outer horizon.
